_comment: Phase 4 entity registry. Each entry maps an id (referenced from rooms.json entities[].type) to a Godot scene path. Per-instance overrides live in the room's entity entry under 'properties'. Tags are per-instance and used by the trigger system for matching.

entities.description: Walks left and right, turns at walls and ledges.
entities.name: Patroller

entities.description: Interactable character. Set 'dialogue_id' property to point at a dialogue.
entities.name: NPC

entities.description: Touch-collectable item. Set 'item_id' property to grant on pickup.
entities.name: Pickup

entities.description: Static interactable sign. Set 'dialogue_id' for a one-shot dialogue.
entities.name: Sign

entities.description: Invisible walk-into zone. Properties: width, height, tag, zone_id, once, event_name, delay_frames. Fires zone_enter/zone_exit (and optional custom event).
entities.name: Trigger Volume
